# Credit Loan Risk Assessment Review

This document details the necessary review and investigation tasks for credit and loan risk assessment within the Credit & Loans department.

## Review Schedule

*   Review the interest rates standard update.
*   Review the borrower credit score quarterly.
*   Review the default risk standard update.

## Investigation Tasks

*   Investigate the collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Investigate the collateral value quarterly.
